name: Lorenzo il Magnifico

categories.label: Victory Points on track (incl. Faith rewards)
categories.labelVi: Điểm chiến thắng trên track (gồm thưởng Đức tin)
categories.hint: VP marker position at game end, after the last Vatican Report (turn 6 Faith reward) and after any excommunication VP penalty applied before final scoring.

categories.label: Excommunication end-game penalty
categories.labelVi: Phạt cuối game do bị rút phép thông công
categories.hint: Only if an excommunication tile says so: -1 VP per 5 VP, per Military Point, per wood/stone in Building costs, or per resource. Enter as a negative number; 0 if none.

categories.label: Territory cards
categories.hint: 1/4/10/20 VP for 3/4/5/6 Territory cards (0-2 cards score nothing).

categories.label: Venture cards
categories.hint: Sum of the VP printed on your Venture cards.

categories.label: Military Strength ranking
categories.labelVi: Xếp hạng Sức mạnh quân sự
categories.hint: Enter Military Points. 1st gets 5 VP, 2nd gets 2 VP. Tied for 1st: all get 5 and nobody gets 2; tied for 2nd: all get 2.

categories.label: Collected resources
categories.hint: Total of wood + stone + coins + servants; 1 VP per 5 (rounded down).

categories.label: Turn order position (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Vị trí thứ tự lượt (phân định hòa)
categories.hint: 1 = first in turn order. Lower number wins a tie.

tiebreakers.description: Player further ahead in turn order wins

notes: family: point-salad-euro. VP are gained during play (track); final scoring adds territories, characters, ventures, military ranking and resources. Faith points are converted to VP at each Vatican Report; at the end of round 6 players short of the required Faith still gain VP for their current Faith step, so include them in trackVp. Not modelled: Leader cards, Personal Bonus Tiles, expansions (Ambition & Glory etc.).
